_comment: Hooks for laravel-plugin. PostToolUse: format the changed PHP file with Laravel Pint. Tries Docker first, falls back to local vendor binary, swallows errors so it never blocks the user.

hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_FILE"; case "$f" in *.php) docker compose exec -T app ./vendor/bin/pint "$f" 2>/dev/null || ./vendor/bin/pint "$f" 2>/dev/null; exit 0;; esac

bash -c 's=""; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../sdlc/hooks/config-protection.sh" ]; then s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../sdlc/hooks/config-protection.sh"; elif [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/config-protection.sh" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/config-protection.sh"; fi; if [ -n "$s" ]; then exec bash "$s" 'pint.json' 'phpstan.neon*' 'phpstan.neon.dist' '.editorconfig'; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Protect this stack's tooling config (pint.json;phpstan.neon*;phpstan.neon.dist;.editorconfig) from being edited mid-run to make a diff pass. Denies only while an sdlc run state file is fresh and task_type is not chore; silent otherwise.

hooks.command: bash -c 's=""; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../sdlc/hooks/post-implement-check.sh" ]; then s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../sdlc/hooks/post-implement-check.sh"; elif [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/post-implement-check.sh" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/post-implement-check.sh"; fi; if [ -n "$s" ]; then exec bash "$s" ./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress --memory-limit=1G; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Batched post-implement check: runs `./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress --memory-limit=1G` once after this stack's architect finishes and relays failures to the orchestrator as a retry hint. Silent when the tool is absent or no run is active.
